gloss: to show; to reveal; to put in an appearance

definitions.gloss: to show, to reveal; to put in an appearance
definitions.explanation: To bring something hidden into view: a person appears ({姿|すがた}を{現|あらわ}す), or a true nature, identity or talent comes out into the open ({正体|しょうたい}を{現|あらわ}す, {頭角|とうかく}を{現|あらわ}す).

examples.japanese: ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}す。
⟦{本性|ほんしょう}→本性：12873_honshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}す。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}した。
⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{正体|しょうたい}→正体：13190_shoutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}す⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people reveal their true selves when they get angry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦{隠|かく}れていた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ついに→遂に：02360_tsuini⟧⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}した。
examples.english: The criminal who had been hiding for a long time finally showed himself in public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{二年目|にねんめ}で、⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{頭角|とうかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}した。
examples.english: In only her second year at the company, she was already standing out from the rest.

notes:
{現|あらわ}す brings into view something that was hidden or not yet seen: a person who appears, or a nature or ability that comes out.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧ (intransitive, to appear)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{姿|すがた}を{現|あらわ}す→姿を現す：16918_sugatawoarawasu⟧: to appear; to show oneself
- ⟦{正体|しょうたい}→正体：13190_shoutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}す: to reveal one's true identity
- ⟦{本性|ほんしょう}→本性：12873_honshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}す: to show one's true colors
- {頭角|とうかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}す: to stand out; to distinguish oneself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express feelings, ideas or meaning in words, gestures or signs. Write ⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧, never {現|あらわ}す: {現|あらわ}す makes something visible, ⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧ puts something inner into outward form.
- ⟦{著|あらわ}す→著す：02279_arawasu⟧: to write and publish a book
